schema.description:
The value of an Emission Activity Parameter or Factor at a given moment in time. Table 188 should
define the argument type (Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor).

When recording a value for Emission Factor, the Emission Activity Parameter ID can be used to define
the foreign activity, and through this association a specific piece of Equipment to which the factor
applies.

Similarly, when recording a value for Emission Activity Parameter, the Emission Factor ID can be
used to define a specific factor that can be applied to the activity to calculate an Emission Statement.
This would be the same Emission Factor ID identified in a Emission Calculation Formula template.
